speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Could I just check, specifically, whether we are looking into the Dependant's Pass application by nurses?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I think we agree that many have gone back home because they want to be closer to their loved ones and they cannot bring their loved ones to Singapore.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And so, two clarifications: one, whether MOH is monitoring how successful their Dependant's Pass application is; and two, whether MOH can work specifically with MOM to see whether we can look into these applications more favourably.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And happy birthday to you as well, Sir.
